As India aggressively expands its Free Trade Agreement (FTA) network, now covering 15 agreements with 27 countries, it faces critical structural challenges that threaten to undermine domestic manufacturing and widen trade deficits. Failure to harmonize input duties with FTA commitments risks weakening domestic value addition and industrial capacity, potentially turning FTAs into a gateway for increased imports rather than export-led growth.
